title: CPSC, Halo Burger Announce Recall of Flashlights and Batteries Sold in Kids Meals
summary: The "AA" batteries provided with each flashlight can leak, which could cause irritation to the skin. When disassembled, the flashlights also have small parts that can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 9,500.

title: CPSC, Stihl Inc. Announce Recall of Chain Saws
summary: Fuel can leak out of the chain saw's tank, which could cause a fire or injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: CPSC, Damo Plus Corp. Announce Recall of Children's School Supply Sets
summary: The sets contain razor knives, which pose a laceration hazard to children. Units: About 26,000.

title: CPSC, Eveready Battery Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Kidz Club Flashlights
summary: The flashlights can overheat and cause the batteries to leak, posing a risk of burns to children. Units: About 24,000.

title: CPSC, Miracle Recreation Equipment Company Announce Recall of Public Playground Equipment Swing Seats
summary: Metal inserts inside the swing seats can wear through and cause lacerations to children. Units: About 22,000.

title: CPSC, Gen-X Sports Incorporated Announce Recall of Skateboard Ramp
summary: The ramps can crack, causing users to fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 88,000.

title: CPSC, Sunrise Medical Announce Recall of 3-Wheel Hand Cycle
summary: There is a small risk that the quick release axles of the rear wheels do not lock correctly. If the quick release axle is not fully and properly engaged, the wheel could become detached while moving. title: CPSC, Good Lad Apparel Announce Recall of Infant Girls' Garment and Shoes
summary: Small decorative items on the garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 52,000.

title: CPSC, Tecumseh Products Co. Announce Recall of Power Equipment Engines
summary: A misrouted fuel line in the engine can become damaged, allowing gasoline to leak out, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 25,000.

title: CPSC, abc Distributing, Inc. Announce Recall of Kid's Tent Set
summary: The tip of the wire that forms the frame for the connecting tunnel can become exposed, resulting in possible laceration injuries. Units: Approximately 15,700.

title: CPSC, Cannondale Corp. Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The front shocks can break apart internally while riding. If this happens, the shock halves can separate, causing the ATV suspension to fail. The operator can lose control of the ATV, possibly resulting in injury or death. Units: About 1,100.

title: CPSC, Honda Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs)
summary: Vehicle Accident Units: About 6,000.

title: CPSC, Baby Trend Announce Recall to Repair Infant Swings Sold at Toys R Us
summary: A screw on the swing's support arm can loosen or detach, causing the seat to separate and drop to one side. This presents a fall hazard to infants. Units: About 15,000.

title: CPSC, Disney Store Announce Recall of Monsters, Inc. Character Plush Dolls
summary: The Boo doll's hair has ponytail holders that could detach, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 14,500.

title: CPSC, Kolcraft Announce Recall of Toy Attachments on Baby Walkers
summary: The flower toys on the baby walker's tray can detach from the stems, exposing sharp edges and posing a laceration hazard to young children. Units: About 410,000.

title: CPSC, Meijer Announce Recall of Three-Tier Tealight Candleholder
summary: The middle candleholder is mounted directly below the top candleholder, which can cause the top candle to overheat and flare. This poses a fire hazard, which can result in a burn injury or property damage. Units: Approximately 1,200.

title: CPSC, Bear Archery LLC Announce Recall of Compound Bows
summary: The limbs of these bows can break during use, causing impact injuries to consumers. Units: About 2,250.

title: CPSC, Estyle, Inc. recall Children's Jackets
summary: The jackets do not meet the Standard for the Flammability of Clothing Textiles under the Federal Flammable Fabrics Act. Units: Approximately 160.

title: CPSC, Evercel Announce Recall of Nickel Zinc Battery Chargers
summary: Internal electrical components of the battery chargers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 460.

title: CPSC, Target Corp. Announce Recall of Men's Sweatshirts
summary: The fleece fabric on the inside of these sweatshirts fails to meet federal mandatory standards of fabric flammability, because it can ignite readily if exposed to flame, and therefore presents a serious risk of burn injuries, in violation of the Federal Flammable Fabrics Act. Units: About 6,000.
